en.headline: Lawmakers call MTR column defects at Tung Chung West unimaginable
en.dek: About 30 concrete columns at the station under construction failed to reach the ceiling, but officials say temporary supports mean there is no structural risk and the 2029 opening target holds.
body: Lawmakers and engineers described as unimaginable the defects found in about 30 concrete columns at the MTR Corporation's Tung Chung West station, which is under construction as part of the Tung Chung Line Extension.

The Buildings Department said the registered structural engineer first identified a problem with one column in early October and ordered the contractor to rectify it. During a routine inspection on 27 October, department officers confirmed two defective columns and instructed a full investigation. By 6 November, after formwork was removed, about 30 columns showed concrete that had not reached the upper slab, leaving reinforcement bars exposed.

The department stressed that temporary supports for the floor slabs remain in place, so the defects do not endanger the unfinished structure. It has required the engineer to submit an investigation report and proposed remedial measures by mid-November. The MTR Corporation ordered relevant work halted after discovering unauthorised remedial attempts.

The Highways Department said it received a report from the MTR on 2 November and has demanded a detailed investigation within two weeks. Officials stated that the contractor will carry out repairs at its own cost and that the 2029 opening target for the extension remains unchanged. Lawmakers urged stronger oversight and a mechanism for frontline workers to report problems.

zh.headline: 議員稱東涌西站支柱欠妥「難以想像」 屋宇署指暫無結構風險
zh.dek: 興建中的東涌西站約30條混凝土柱未能灌至天花，但屋宇署指樓板臨時支撐仍在，不構成結構危險，2029年通車目標維持。
body: 議員及工程師形容港鐵東涌西站發現約30條混凝土柱欠妥的情況「難以想像」。東涌西站屬東涌綫延綫工程一部分，目前正在興建。
屋宇署表示，項目註冊結構工程師團隊於10月初發現一條混凝土柱有問題，已指示承建商糾正。署方人員於10月27日例行地盤視察時確認兩條柱有欠妥情況，要求全面調查。至11月6日模板拆除後，共約30條柱出現混凝土未到達上層樓板的情況，鋼筋外露。
署方強調樓板的臨時支撐尚未拆除，有關欠妥情況不會對未完工結構構成危險。已要求註冊結構工程師於11月中提交調查報告及建議補救措施。港鐵公司在發現未經批准的修補工序後，已指令暫停相關施工。
路政署稱11月2日接獲港鐵通報，已要求兩星期內提交詳細調查報告，並指示承建商自資進行修復。署方表示東涌綫延綫2029年通車目標維持不變。議員促請加強監督，並設立前線工人匯報機制。
